query: I just got back from walking my dog this afternoon, he stopped to sniff every single dandelion on the sidewalk and even tried to carry a half-eaten french fry he found home with him. I was also planning out my weekend gardening schedule earlier, I need to pick up some new potting soil and a few packets of marigold seeds to plant along the edge of my balcony. Oh, and I finished that mystery novel I’ve been reading for the past week last night, the ending had such a wild twist I never saw coming. Anyway, I need to modify my pending order #W9911714, please change the items 9791469541 and 1340995114 to 4107812777 and 1421289881, and use gift_card_4332117 as the payment method for the adjustment.
